decision: Choose when to stop questioning, continue, or send a case to specialist review.
primary_outcome: Wrong definitive eligibility decisions divided by all definitive decisions, reported jointly with definitive-decision coverage.
denominator: All eligible assigned households for coverage; all definitive decisions for selective risk. Never mix these denominators.
independence_unit: Household; multiple states and questions from one household are dependent.
quality_guardrail: Simultaneous upper risk bound over the fixed candidate threshold grid; subgroup coverage and review load reported separately.
minimum_data: Household ID, frozen policy and threshold-grid version, question history, definitive/abstain result, oracle or adjudicated label and provenance, review time.
failure_handling: Abstentions remain in the coverage denominator. Unknown truth prevents certification for the affected outcome; missing labels are not correct answers.
release_rule: Only certify when the documented calibration assumptions and prespecified risk ceiling hold; otherwise abstain. Synthetic activation cannot satisfy this gate.
reversal: Changed question policy, shifted eligible population, or inadequate calibration support requires recertification.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: More definitive answers can conceal more harmful errors. I constrain risk first and then compare coverage and reviewer effort.
It establishes answers within the modeled household rules. It does not establish real applicant behavior or deployment exchangeability.
